audio.text: Weren't you supposed to be in Chicago this week?

options: Chicago is great in the summer.
My flight got canceled because of the storm.
Yes, I lived there for two years.
I'm supposed to call them later.

why.en: Explains why the plan changed. D reuses "supposed to".
why.tr: Planın neden değiştiğini açıklıyor. D "supposed to" ifadesini tekrar ediyor.
